title: Resolve, to Establish the Commission to Study the Need to Codify or Recodify Laws Regarding Residential Community Ownership Associations by Adopting the Uniform Common Interest Ownership Act (TITLE CHANGE)

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill would establish the Maine Common Interest Ownership Act based on the 2021 version of the Uniform Common Interest Ownership Act, the text of which may be found here: https://legislature.maine.gov/doc/11388.
